notes.title: At last, a promise fulfilled.
notes.content:
My very first — and most heartfelt — game is now free to play. It’s been a long road. I’ve been developing games since 2017. There were highs, there were lows, but I’ve always loved what I do.

I hope new players will give this project a chance. Yes, it’s aged — but even now, I believe it still looks and plays better than some newer releases.

We’ve also added a full French translation — completely free. This has been a frequent request for a long time, and we made sure to include it before switching to the free version. The translation isn’t perfect, but I hope it won’t ruin the experience.

Unfortunately, this milestone was somewhat overshadowed by the recent rejection of our new project. Many of you have already seen the news. It’s disappointing — the new game is clearly strong, and had great potential to succeed financially. When I first released it, I was anxious. But now I see it for what it is: a potential hit. Still, without Steam and its reach, there’s only so much ground we can cover.

But as someone once said — an artist must stay hungry.

So we’ll continue working. Sales from Void Calling and the promising growth of Boundaries of Morality give me hope that we’ll finish what we started — and finish it well.

You won’t see us on Steam for a couple of years. I prefer to complete what I begin.

Thank you all.
And have a great day.

notes.title: Twists of My Life Will Be Free in a Month!
notes.content:
Twists of My Life Will Be Free in a Month!

Hello, friends!

I have some important news to share—Twists of My Life will become completely free in just one month!

This was my very first game, and while it may seem a bit clumsy by today's visual novel standards, it remains the most sincere one to me. It was inspired by my own relationships—many of the female characters have real-life counterparts, and their personalities were shaped by genuine emotions and experiences.

But time moves on, and now it's time to make this story available to everyone.

What’s Next?
We haven’t stood still since Twists of My Life! We've worked on new projects, including:

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45213/Voids_Calling_complete/]Void’s Calling[/url] series – deeper, more immersive games with rich storytelling.

The upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3504360/Boundaries_of_Morality/?beta=0]"Boundaries of Morality"[/url] – a new project where we’ve put even more experience and passion into the narrative.

If you enjoy our work, you’re always welcome to support us and explore our latest games!

Thank you for being part of this journey! 💜

notes.title: Chinese translation / 中文翻译
notes.content:
要下载中文翻译，你需要在Steam应用设置中选择它。
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/9MCFYjdf/image.png[/img]
你也可以查看属性：
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/28cGpkyP/image.png[/img]
(默认为英文)。
如果你在下载中文版本时有不同的语言，你需要删除这个路径中的所有文件：...:\Users\....\AppData\Roaming\RenPy\ToML-1508747737
如果你没有这个文件夹，你需要在你的电脑设置中启用这个文件夹的可见性。
如果你之前下载了不同语言的游戏，就会出现这个错误。
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MKk3PKct/image.png[/img]

To download the Chinese translation, you need to select it in the Steam app settings.
You can also check the properties:
https://i.postimg.cc/wTwBqY8G/image.png
(English by default).
If you have a different language when downloading the Chinese version, you need to delete all files in this path: ...:\Users\....\AppData\Roaming\RenPy\ToML-1508747737
If you don't have this folder, you need to enable visibility of this folder in your PC settings.
This error occurs if you have previously downloaded the game in a different language.

notes.title: Soundtrack has been added into the game (ToML-1.1.2).
notes.content:
By popular demand, a soundtrack has been added.
There are not too many tracks, only four. Unfortunately, we do not have time to deal with our old projects at all.
This game was first and as the first love, it means a lot to us and it will forever remain in our memory, like something light and warm. And it doesn't matter that after a while, our first love no longer seems as dazzlingly beautiful as we saw it in our youth. She is the best, simply because she was the most sincere.

notes.title: Void's Calling ep. 1
notes.content:
We have finally completed the first episode of our new game "Void's Calling". It was released on Steam today, so you can buy it there if you want.

This game has a new setting and a genre compared to the previous one. Void's Calling is a game set in the Middle Ages with a relatively open world and RPG elements.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212020/Voids_Calling_ep1/]Void's Calling ep. 1[/url]

notes.title: Good News
notes.content:
Hello, 
I have two news for you and both of them seem to be quite good. The first news is about collection cards, they have finally been approved for release. You can get cards, badges, emoticons, even backgrounds to customize your Steam profile. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/8PrhPYt7/cart-6c.jpg[/img]

The second news is about Alanna's expanded ending that has been added to the Steam version of the game. Those who have already bought the game will receive this content for no additional cost. However, we will slightly raise the price of the game to reflect this change. 

Thank you for your interest in our work.
